name: micro-frontend-dashboard
description: Production-oriented Micro-Frontend Dashboard with Module Federation

scripts.predev: npm run kill-ports && npm run build:remotes
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,auth,dash,users,analytics,notif,shell -c gray,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red,blue "npm run dev -w @mfd/api-server" "npm run dev -w @mfd/auth" "npm run dev -w @mfd/dashboard" "npm run dev -w @mfd/user-management" "npm run dev -w @mfd/analytics" "npm run dev -w @mfd/notifications" "npm run dev:delayed -w @mfd/shell"
scripts.build:remotes: concurrently -n auth,dash,users,analytics,notif -c green,yellow,magenta,cyan,red "npm run build -w @mfd/auth" "npm run build -w @mfd/dashboard" "npm run build -w @mfd/user-management" "npm run build -w @mfd/analytics" "npm run build -w @mfd/notifications"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mfd/shared-types && npm run build -w @mfd/shared-utils && npm run build -w @mfd/shared-auth && npm run build -w @mfd/shared-ui && npm run build -w @mfd/auth && npm run build -w @mfd/dashboard && npm run build -w @mfd/user-management && npm run build -w @mfd/analytics && npm run build -w @mfd/notifications && npm run build -w @mfd/shell
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/shell && tsc --noEmit -p modules/auth && tsc --noEmit -p modules/dashboard && tsc --noEmit -p modules/user-management && tsc --noEmit -p modules/analytics && tsc --noEmit -p modules/notifications
